meta.title: Wayfare: every way to travel, side by side

hero.badge: Real timetables · today's prices · hourly rain forecast
hero.title: Not sure how to get there?
hero.titleAccent: We'll compare every way, rain included
hero.subtitle: Skytrain, bus, boat, taxi, train, coach, flight. We line them all up from your door to theirs, so you know when to leave, how long each step takes and what the whole trip costs. Then book every leg in one payment.

modes.title: How do you want to go?
modes.subtitle: Tap one to see a sample route

hint.metro: BTS · MRT · Airport Rail Link · Red Line
hint.boat: Chao Phraya express and canal boats

compare.title: Every option, one search
compare.body: No more six tabs and a calculator. Search once and see every way to go, sorted by what matters to you.

realtime.title: Real times and prices for your day
realtime.body: See how long you'll walk, wait and ride, and what it costs on the day you're actually travelling.

weather.title: Know before it rains
weather.body: Rain on the way? We tell you before you leave and suggest a dry option.

search.title: Search
search.body: Tell us where from, where to, when, and how many of you.

priority.title: Pick what matters
priority.body: Fastest, cheapest, best value or most comfortable. The list re-sorts as you tap.

best.title: See your plan
best.body: Every step timed, the total cost, the weather, and when to leave home.

book.title: Book it in one go
book.body: Pay once for every leg you can book. Tickets land in the app, and you're refunded automatically if a service is cancelled.

operator.title: Get paid the moment you scan a ticket
operator.body: Passengers pay up front and the money waits in escrow. Scan their ticket when they board and it's yours. Cancel a trip and everyone is refunded automatically.
